properties.description:
Two tests in `crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_levied_requirement_is_recordable_in_one_call.rs`: `add_requirement` carrying `source` and `provenance: imported` lands both and still lands at `proposed`; and omitting them leaves the schema default exactly as it was, so the parameters add a way to SAY and never an obligation to.

OBSERVED FAILING before the fix in the strongest available sense — the request type had no such fields, so it did not compile.

RE-RUN: `cargo test -p reflow2-mcp --test a_levied_requirement_is_recordable_in_one_call`.
properties.findings: 2/2 green 2026-09-22. toolsnap reported exactly one changed tool — add_requirement — which was blessed deliberately; every surface gate green after.
properties.name: The documented path for a consumer's levied requirement completes in one call, and omitting the fields still leaves the default
